commands.title: Capture · Inspect service diagnostic log
commands.command: (umask 077; b=/tmp/bc-1f881ad92c5ad05599d8641c; mkdir "$b" && { { env TERM=dumb PAGER=cat SYSTEMD_PAGER=cat cat /tmp/blackcat-image-demo.log </dev/null; echo $? >"$b/s"; } 2>&1 | { head -c 1048576 >"$b/r"; cat >/dev/null; }; LC_ALL=C cat -v "$b/r" | fold -w 64 >"$b/o"; printf '\nBC1f881ad92c5ad05599d8641c_CAP_'; cat "$b/s"; })

commands.title: Read output · page 1 · Inspect service diagnostic log
commands.command:
(b=/tmp/bc-1f881ad92c5ad05599d8641c; printf '
BC1f881ad92c5ad05599d8641c_P1_1_8_BEGIN
'; sed -n '1,8p' "$b/o"; printf '
BC1f881ad92c5ad05599d8641c_P1_1_8_END_'; tr -d '
' <"$b/s"; if [ "$(awk 'END{print NR}' <"$b/o")" -gt 8 ]; then echo _MORE; else echo _DONE; fi)
